description: Phase 4 step 4 measurement (not a gate). Kerr, camera at 1000 M, model sky +-22 M, thin disk g^4 F(r) tau(r) (taper from 0.75 r_out), RK4 step fraction 0.01, fp64 unless stated. Total-flux gradient from the fixed-sample quadrature with forward-mode tangents (no critical-curve edge term), on 128^2 and 1024^2 stratified samples, against central differences of the 1024^2 (8 x 8 per cell) flux at steps h0 and h0/2. The map is sum over samples per bin of w (FD_s - tangent_s) at h0, divided by |FD gradient at h0/2|, on a 64 x 64 grid over the model sky (row = y). fp32: the same tangents from the fp32 module; clipping caps |dI| at a percentile of the fp64 per-sample magnitudes.
